title: Communicating with Others
description: Talk about yourself and about your friends and tell how a friendship began, was lost and was renewed, with the past simple and its markers ago, at that time and then; announce an intention already formed with be going to + verb, and keep it apart from will + verb, which takes a decision at the moment of speaking and makes a promise, an offer or a prediction, from the present continuous of a fixed arrangement and from the present simple of a timetable; express attitudes and feelings towards a friend in difficulty (to comfort, to feel small, to take somebody's part, to ease somebody's mind, to be weary, a tear, hopeless, depressed, a bridge, to sail, to shine); and describe and analyse behaviour by naming the cause (because, since, as, because of + noun) and the result (so, therefore, as a result, that's why, so … that, such … that) with the punctuation each one needs — all through the vocabulary of friendship (keep in touch, lose touch, website, password, intimate, renew, waitress, incredible), the adjectives that judge a friend (honest, faithful, loyal, sincere, open-minded, negligent, indifferent, narrow-minded), the vocabulary of communication (needy, appeal, smiley, desperate, inbox, confess, discreet, anonymity, concise, hooked, shy, conflict, to handle) and the difference between the register of an e-mail and the register of a text message
sources: Official programme transcript - content/programmes-officiels/programme/2eme-sec/anglais.md, section 4 bis "Chapitre 02 - 02-communicating-with-others" (Theme II, lessons 3-5, p. 33-41) and section 2 "Book Map", Theme II (Functions / Grammar / Vocabulary of L3, L4 and L5)
